name: mem_carve
description: Sweep a memory image, page file or hibernation file for the structures that carry time and identity — registry hives, event log chunks, prefetch records, PE headers, SQLite databases, MFT and INDX records — and return each hit with its offset, optionally cutting it out for the parser that reads it.

path.description: A memory image, pagefile.sys, hiberfil.sys or any blob

kinds.description: Only these kinds, e.g. ["registry hive","event log chunk"]

extract_to.description: Cut each hit out to this directory, under work/

max_extract.description: How many hits to cut out (default 25)

start.description: Byte offset to start the sweep at
